title.zh: 将卡加延省 Solana 市镇定为该省第二众议员选区公路工程区所在地的法案
title.en: An Act Making the Municipality of Solana, Province of Cagayan, as the Seat of the Highway Engineering District of the Second Congressional District of the Said Province
title.orig: An Act Making the Municipality of Solana, Province of Cagayan, as the Seat of the Highway Engineering District of the Second Congressional District of the Said Province

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5300_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Municipality of Solana, Province of Cagayan, is hereby made the seat of the highway engineering district of the second congressional district of the same province.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 15, 1968.
